description: This Java class StringUtil provides miscellaneous string utility functions, including string replacement, splitting, joining, encoding/decoding, and operator substitution conversions, as well as a StringWrapper inner class for template use.

classes.name: StringWrapper
classes.description: A lightweight wrapper for String objects, mainly used in templates to avoid HTML auto-encoding.

methods.name: internString
methods.description: Returns the interned version of the input string.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another string.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a collection of objects into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a list based on a delimiter.

methods.name: strToMap
methods.description: Converts a delimited string into a map of key-value pairs, with optional trimming and decoding.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a list into a List object.

methods.name: toSet
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a set into a Set object.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Creates a map from two lists of keys and values.

methods.name: cleanUpPathPrefix
methods.description: Ensures a path prefix starts with '/' and does not end with '/', converting backslashes to slashes.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all spaces from a string.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: cleanHexString
methods.description: Removes spaces and colons from a hex string.

methods.name: fromHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string back to a byte array.

methods.name: encodeInt
methods.description: Encodes an integer into a character array as hex.

methods.name: removeNonNumeric
methods.description: Removes all non-numeric characters from a string.

methods.name: removeRegex
methods.description: Removes all matches of a regex from a string.

methods.name: addToNumberString
methods.description: Adds a number to a numeric string, padding with zeros to original length.

methods.name: padNumberString
methods.description: Pads a numeric string with leading zeros to reach a minimum length.

methods.name: convertOperatorSubstitutions
methods.description: Replaces operator placeholders (@and, @or, etc.) with their symbolic equivalents.

methods.name: wrapString
methods.description: Wraps a string in a StringWrapper object.

methods.name: makeStringWrapper
methods.description: Creates a StringWrapper object, returning a singleton empty wrapper if input is empty.
